text:
maria_g: Quick huddle on keyword-first launch tasks for the product launch + webinar. Focus areas: keyword mapping for launch posts, event schema, redirects for legacy resources, and inbound lead tagging.
dan_p: Agree. I can own the redirects CSV + rollout. Want to ensure we keep breadcrumb structure for SEO.
ryan_h: I'll do the keyword map and lightweight meta/descriptions. Can we prioritize long-tail phrases around "LLM inference cost" and "GPU inference latency" for benchmark posts?
julia_m: Messaging iteration note: we should test 2 headlines for blog + 1 for webinar landing. Which KPI? page CTR and registration conversion.
seo-bot: Suggestion: run keyword visibility snapshot after staging publish: /tools/visibility-snapshot?site=redwood.dev&tag=launch_q2
dan_p: Redirect examples I'll push to GH (samples):
```
from,to,status
/2019/llm-costs,/resources/launch/llm-costs,301
/blog/old-benchmarks,/resources/launch/benchmarks,301
/events/live-demo,/events/launch-2026/register,302
```
maria_g: Keep the events/register as 302 during promo, switch to 301 when archived. Also add rel=canonical on any republished excerpts pointing to the hub.
ryan_h: Keyword map (top lines):
- llm inference cost optimization
- reduce llm latency gpu batching
- open-source inference benchmarks redwood
I'll craft metas: 120-155 chars, include primary keyword early.
julia_m: For internal linking: add hub banner to product pages, link from docs/serving-runtime -> benchmarks article, and add footer CTA on top 50 pages by sessions.
seo-bot: Reminder: include FAQPage JSON-LD for common Qs (pricing, SLAs, privacy) and Event schema for webinar.
ryan_h: Draft Event + FAQ JSON-LD (short):
```
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference Launch Webinar","startDate":"2026-04-14T16:00:00Z","eventAttendanceMode":"https://schema.org/OnlineEventAttendanceMode","organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}
```
and FAQ structure for gating questions.
dan_p: After redirects deploy, I'll run an automated redirect smoke test and then a canonical crawl. Schedule that for Fri AM.
maria_g: Lead routing: use UTM mapping -> SFDC campaign. Proposed UTMs: utm_source=organic, utm_medium=webinar, utm_campaign=launch_q2. Hidden field webinar_id + utm_campaign on forms.
julia_m: A/B test headlines: H1A = "Reduce LLM inference costs: benchmarks & tactics" vs H1B = "How we cut token costs by 3x with batching" — track CTR.
seo-bot: Crawl scheduled: 2026-04-18T08:00Z for staging smoke; 2026-04-21T09:00Z for post-publish canonical checks.
maria_g: Owners: redirects -> @dan_p, keywords & metas -> @ryan_h, schema -> @ryan_h, internal links -> @maria_g, UTMs -> @julia_m. Publish owner = growth-marketing.
dan_p: I'll raise PR with redirects CSV + rollout notes. ETA Thu noon.
ryan_h: I'll drop keyword map + meta drafts by Wed EOD.
julia_m: I'll prepare GTM QA checklist and SFDC mapping doc tomorrow.
maria_g: Great work. Keep thread updated with PR links and GH tickets. :rocket:
